verdict.rationale: Requesty's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (docs-1, docs-2) means tool/function-calling requests use the standard OpenAI schema, and docs-31 explicitly states 'Pass a single tool definition and Requesty translates it to the right provider format automatically' for tools like web search, showing schema normalization across providers. Structured-output docs (docs-14, docs-27) reinforce 'One API, consistent behavior, regardless of the underlying provider.' Missing for 10: dedicated documentation specifically covering generic function/tool-calling (beyond the single web-search example) across all 300+/600+ providers, and independent/hands-on verification that arbitrary custom tool schemas are reliably translated for non-OpenAI models.
